attestations.text: CHANG Yin-huan 張蔭桓 (T. 樵野, H. 紅棉主人), Feb. 8, 1837–1900, Aug. 20, diplomat, was a native of the town of Fo-shan (Fatshan) in the district of Nan-hai (Canton). As a young man he was talented and adventurous.
